changes.reason: Generate literal, file-scoped Vitest replay and native-ID Playwright replay while preserving caller-provided replay commands and explicit package namespaces.

kubernetes.reason: Replay commands are generated and consumed by local Node test runners; the Kubernetes Node Host does not participate in test selection or shell argument handling.
constraints: Replay uses the existing POSIX shell command contract on the development or CI runner; no deployment runtime claim changes.
